sources.title: Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Standard Bangla Grammar)
sources.citation: Bangla Academy. (2012). Pramanik Bangla Byakaran (Vols. 1-3, Ed. Rafiqul Islam & Pabitra Sarkar). Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Authoritative standard for Bangladesh grammar, orthography, and morphology. Used strictly for rule extraction and morphological paradigms; no bulk text copying.

sources.title: Bangla Academy Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom (Standard Bangla Spelling Rules)
sources.citation: Bangla Academy. (2016). Promito Bangla Bananer Niyom. Dhaka: Bangla Academy.
sources.notes: Authoritative baseline for orthographic normalization, consonant doubling rules, and vowel harmony orthography.

sources.title: The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language
sources.citation: Chatterji, S. K. (1926). The Origin and Development of the Bengali Language. Calcutta: Calcutta University Press.
sources.notes: Foundational historical and comparative phonology, morphology, and dialectal evolution treatise.

sources.title: Universal Dependencies Bengali Treebank
sources.citation: Universal Dependencies Consortium. (2023). Universal Dependencies Treebank for Bengali (Release 2.12).
sources.notes: Reference for cross-linguistic dependency relations, UPOS tagging, and morphological feature mapping.
